subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: Insert service of the rich text editor that inserts a map. The address typed in the selector is geocoded by the Geoplateforme service (data.geopf.fr, no key); width, height and zoom are chosen with a preview. The inserted content is a Plan IGN image (Geoplateforme WMS, Etalab 2.0 licence) centered on the address with a marker image at its center, linked to the OpenStreetMap page of the point. The markup only uses what the HTML filter of the Lutece 8 back office keeps (it removes frames, positioning and background images): the marker is placed by a zero-height block, text-align and padding-top, without script.

subsection.name: Site configuration
subsection.p: The default security headers of Lutece 8 block any third-party image and request. In "System / Security header Management", for the back office and the front office pages:

ul.li: Content-Security-Policy: add https://data.geopf.fr to img-src (the map image) and to connect-src (back office, address search);
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp refuses the map image, which data.geopf.fr serves without a Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header; set credentialless.
